description: Best-effort importance display line composed from scenario-dependency-analyzer centrality and swarm-manager recent-activity, with a hard 1s combined budget, silently omitted when sources are unreachable; the core score path never touches the network.

requirements.description: The score response may optionally include an importance display line composed from: (a) centrality data from scenario-dependency-analyzer and (b) recent-activity data from swarm-manager. These two network calls share a combined hard timeout budget of 1 second. If either or both sources are unreachable, time out, or return errors within the budget, the importance line is silently omitted from the response — no error is surfaced to the caller and no degradation is reported. The core score path (composite score, rung, freshness, recommendations) must complete entirely before importance enrichment is attempted and must not be blocked by it. Network calls for importance enrichment must be the ONLY network touches in the entire score response lifecycle.
requirements.title: Best-Effort Importance Enrichment with 1s Combined Budget and Silent Omission
